text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs by observing the symptoms and understanding what the code should do. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and error messages, help you find where the problem starts. A systematic approach is essential: test one part at a time and check your assumptions instead of changing code randomly. Logging is also very useful because it records what happens while the program runs, so you can see where things go wrong. With patience and the right strategies, most bugs can be found and fixed.
